display.purpose: Hero headlines only, one per page.

headline.purpose: Section headers, always preceded by an eyebrow label.

data.purpose: Query strings, rank positions, stat figures — measured values, never prose.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default state for cards, inputs, and the outline button.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color, shadow, and transform transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. One accent-colored control per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 10px 24px; background: oklch(0.50 0.14 200); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.50 0.14 200) 90%, black); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.50 0.14 200 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 10px 24px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); }

components.name: Default Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: oklch(0.50 0.14 200); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat content container, hairline border, resting shadow.
components.html:
Relevance

Results look right. They're not.

Top queries return plausible products, but bestsellers are buried and weak matches surface first.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.5); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.556 0 0 / 0.5); margin: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); margin: 8px 0 0; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input, hairline border, ring focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); outline: none; transition: box-shadow 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.50 0.14 200); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.50 0.14 200 / 0.5); }

components.name: Spine Nav
components.description: Signature vertical scroll-spy rail: a hairline connecting line with dot markers, one per page section.
components.css: .ds-spine { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-spine-line { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 1px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: oklch(0.922 0 0); } .ds-spine-dot { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; width: 44px; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-spine-dot:hover { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-spine-dot span { display: block; height: 12px; width: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.556 0 0 / 0.7); background: oklch(1 0 0); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-spine-dot--active span { background: oklch(0.145 0 0); border-color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

narrative.overview:
Find Sherpas reads a search system the way an instrument reads a signal: calmly, precisely, without editorializing. The surface is quiet by default — a near-white canvas, hairline borders, restrained type — so that when something needs attention (a CTA, a finding, a live data figure) it registers as a genuine signal rather than one more loud element competing for the eye. A single narrow "spine" rail tracks position down the page like a gauge, and raw data — queries, rankings, stats — switches into a monospace register that visually separates measurement from narrative prose.

The voice is diagnostic and evidence-led: short declarative sentences, uppercase micro-labels as section eyebrows, findings stated plainly before any pitch. Confidence comes from clarity and restraint, not decoration. Explicitly rejected: the generic SaaS look — gradient meshes, glassmorphism, glowing blob backgrounds, purple-to-blue washes. This system stays flat, hairline-bordered, and typographically led.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white canvas with a single sparing teal accent
A narrow scroll-spy "spine" rail as the signature navigation device
Monospace type reserved for data/query figures, never for prose
Uppercase, wide-tracked micro-labels as section eyebrows
Flat surfaces at rest; shadow appears only as a response to interaction

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal appears on at most one element per screen at rest — the primary action. Everything else stays neutral so the accent keeps its meaning as "the thing to do here," not decoration. Scoped exception: the sticky header's Book a call button is exempt, since persistent navigation chrome is expected to keep its own affordance visible through scroll.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Any figure that represents a measured or literal value — a search query, a rank position, a stat — is set in Geist Mono. Sentences, headlines, and labels never are.

rules.name: The Ambient-on-Interaction Rule
rules.body: Nothing is elevated by default. Shadow only appears, or deepens, in direct response to hover/focus/state change.

dos: Do hold Signal Teal for one element per screen — the primary action or an active-state indicator.
Do set any measured/literal figure (query, rank, stat) in Geist Mono; keep all prose in Geist Sans.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and let shadow communicate interactivity, not decoration.
Do center content in reading-width containers (576–1120px) rather than stretching full-bleed.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, or glow effects — the explicit anti-reference for this system is the generic SaaS template look.
Don't add a second accent color; route additional emphasis through Ink weight/size or the Teal Wash tint instead.
Don't collapse the spine into a hamburger menu on mobile — hide it and let the page scroll normally.
